proposed_claim: ARCCRAFT is a procedural multi-period actuarial stress-testing architecture
required_evidence: Formal specification mapped to implementation
current_evidence: Engine and configuration repository inspected; formal mapping still required
allowed_wording: ARCCRAFT is proposed and implemented as a procedural multi-period architecture

proposed_claim: ARCCRAFT is a validated framework
required_evidence: Independent predictive validation, matched benchmarks, ablations and robustness
current_evidence: Only retrospective 2024 check; tail criterion fails; no matched benchmark
allowed_wording: Use preliminary evaluation, not validated framework

proposed_claim: ARCCRAFT improves actuarial stress testing
required_evidence: Pre-specified superiority or non-inferiority tests against matched baselines
current_evidence: No comparator results
allowed_wording: Do not claim improvement

proposed_claim: ARCCRAFT generates reproducible worlds
required_evidence: Repeated registered runs with code, environment, configuration and seed hashes
current_evidence: Exact same-seed replay passed for labels, gates and floating-point outputs; cross-platform and environment-locked tests absent
allowed_wording: Runs replay exactly in the inspected local environment under the registered seed

proposed_claim: Independent random streams improve reproducibility or isolation
required_evidence: Shared-stream ablation and component-level counterfactual replay
current_evidence: Full model invariant after 100 unused world-stream draws; shared-stream fingerprint changes
allowed_wording: Named PCG64 substreams isolate claim and behavioural results from irrelevant world-stream consumption in the inspected environment

proposed_claim: The validator improves scenario quality
required_evidence: Consistency metrics plus distributional comparison with no-validator and reject-only ablations
current_evidence: No-validator and strict-reject ablations executed across three seeds, but no external plausibility criterion
allowed_wording: The validator enforces coded structural rules and changes the selected scenario population; improved plausibility is not demonstrated

proposed_claim: Repaired worlds remain statistically plausible
required_evidence: Empirical or formal plausibility test before and after repair
current_evidence: Not tested
allowed_wording: Do not claim

proposed_claim: The Failure Atlas identifies causes of model vulnerability
required_evidence: Fault-injection ground truth or causal identification; comparator attribution metrics
current_evidence: Internal seed-to-threshold records only
allowed_wording: The Failure Atlas records variables and conditions associated with coded failures
